title: MSFS Marketplace Update: Belfast City, Cape May & 1935 Hamburg
description:
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for April 26, 2026 is packed with must-have new releases for PC simmers, featuring highly anticipated international airports like Porto and Oslo alongside immersive new regional sceneries you’ll want in your hangar. Today, we’re testing the "Wooden Wonder" historical collection from Redwing and the new high-fidelity hub in Northern Ireland.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:
🛫 Fly X Simulations: EGAC Belfast City Airport (The vital gateway to Northern Ireland with full interior)
🛫 Redwing Simulations: 1935 Hamburg Airport (Historical 1930s recreation of one of the world's oldest airports)
🛫 Redwing Simulations: 1935 Berlin Tempelhof (The legendary German hub in its 1920s/30s glory)🛫 Spinoza: KWWD Cape May Airport (Featuring the NAS Wildwood Aviation Museum and Vietnam museum)
🛫 Redwing Simulations: 1935 Lakehurst Maxfield (Historical airship base recreation)
🛫 Redwing Simulations: 1945 Moffett Field (Massive historical naval air station)
🛫 Hungary Airport Pack 2: LHM/LHMP (Ultra-high resolution drone-scanned regional airports)
🛫 MSF Scenery Builders: KFMN Four Corners Regional (Detailed New Mexico hub)  

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 DreamScenery: VFR Objects Rotterdam (Enhanced industrial harbor landmarks)
🌆 DreamScenery: VFR Objects Houston/Tokyo/Miami (VFR landmark packages)
🌆 DreamScenery: Munich Night Enhanced (Updated night lighting environment)
🌆 DreamScenery: Toronto Night Enhanced (Atmospheric nighttime overhaul)
🌆 DreamScenery: Alicante Night Enhanced (Night flying upgrade for Spain)
